identity_resolution.finding: The MMSI matched by name search (636021179) reported a live position on 2026-06-24 at 51.365397N, 2.469022E — in the North Sea off Zeebrugge, Belgium — making 11.8 knots. That is not consistent with a Liberia-flagged bulk carrier reported sunk in the Red Sea on 2024-06-12.
identity_resolution.conclusion: Either the MMSI was reassigned to a different vessel after the loss, or the name search matched an unrelated ship that happens to share the name Tutor. This does not cast doubt on the original sinking report — it means our identity match was wrong, not that Reuters was wrong.
identity_resolution.action: IMO 9942627 and MMSI 636021179 removed as this vessel's confirmed identifiers pending a proper Equasis lookup.

vessel.name: Honour 25
vessel.note: Flag changed from Cameroon to Palau. The hull was still transmitting on 2026-09-04, after the reported April 2026 hijack.

records.position_note: Approximately 30 nautical miles off the Somali coast, off Puntland
records.date_note: Reported as 21 April by Ambrey and other outlets; the Wikipedia summary gives 22 April.

post_incident_tracking.finding: AIS position and a 7-day history track (82 points) show the vessel stationary at 9.2096N, 50.7078E — off the Somali coast, in the Hobyo/Garacad area historically used as a pirate anchorage — with speed under 1 knot throughout and no meaningful movement in a week.
post_incident_tracking.destination_field: AIS destination field reads 'MOGADISHO..ARMGAURD..' (as transmitted, likely a garbled 'ARM GUARD')
post_incident_tracking.interpretation_note: Not established which of these is true: the vessel remains held at anchor, it is awaiting an armed guard team out of Mogadisho, or it already has one aboard. The destination string is the vessel's own AIS transmission and could be inaccurate or manually miskeyed.
post_incident_tracking.why_it_matters: If accurate, this is the most concrete real-time signal in this library of an active hijacking situation.

ownership_research.status: no owner, manager or charterer identified in any source found
ownership_research.checked: BBC and Maritime Optima follow-up coverage through 5 May 2026, plus a fresh search on 2026-09-04.
ownership_research.new_fact: Maritime Optima reports the vessel was confirmed seized by EUNAVFOR Operation Atalanta on 27 April 2026 and moved deep into Somali territorial waters. That is the last substantive status found; it predates the vessel's current position by over four months and does not explain why it is showing live AIS off Hobyo/Garacad with an 'ARM GUARD' destination string as of 2026-09-04.

records.crew_effect: Reported as the second hijacking in four days.

records.response: Turkish and Somali forces. Somali authorities reported 14 pirates killed in a 10-day operation.

identity_note: IMO and MMSI for Tutor, Eternity C, Maersk Yorktown and Honour 25 resolved via the ShipFinder AIS API on 2026-09-04. Two carry date anomalies, recorded in ais_anomalies rather than smoothed over.
